purpose: Organize multiple specialized systems into governed domains with clear architecture, integration, authority boundaries, and runtime interoperability.

domains.market: exchange readiness, market infrastructure, metals, gold, silver, finance
domains.technology: runtime kernel, AI, databases, APIs, cloud, datacenter
domains.science: computing, calculation, research, engineering, applied sciences
domains.external_systems: Linux, Windows, macOS, cloud, data centers, enterprise systems

rule: Each domain may have its own scope, structure, architecture, permissions, APIs, evidence, and governance, but all domains must integrate through Sheikha governance and federation.
